examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}を{認|みと}める。
{彼|かれ}の{努力|どりょく}は{皆|みな}に{認|みと}められている。
examples.english: His effort is recognized by everyone.

examples.japanese: {正式|せいしき}に{資格|しかく}を{認|みと}められた。
{間違|まちが}いを{認|みと}める。
{自分|じぶん}の{非|ひ}を{認|みと}めた。
examples.english: I admitted I was in the wrong.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はなかなか{自分|じぶん}の{失敗|しっぱい}を{認|みと}めようとしない。
examples.english: He is reluctant to admit his own failure.

notes:
{認|みと}める has two main uses: to recognize/acknowledge something, or to admit/confess.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {才能|さいのう}を{認|みと}める: to recognize talent
- {間違|まちが}いを{認|みと}める: to admit a mistake
- {正式|せいしき}に{認|みと}める: to officially recognize
- 〜と{認|みと}める: to acknowledge that ~

PASSIVE FORM:
{認|みと}められる: to be recognized/acknowledged

RELATED:
- {認|みと}め{印|いん}: personal seal, approval stamp
- {承認|しょうにん}: approval, authorization
